in_sanskrit.name: कस्तुरिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कस्तुरिका (Kasturika) is derived from the Sanskrit word कस्तूर (kastūr), which means turmeric. The suffix -िका (-ikā) denotes a female. So, Kasturika means 'covered with turmeric'.

in_hindi.name: कस्तूरिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Kasturika is a Sanskrit name, which is also used in Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word कस्तूर (kastūr), which means turmeric. The suffix -िका (-ikā) denotes a female. So, Kasturika means 'covered with turmeric' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: கச்துரிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kasturika is a Sanskrit name, which is also used in Tamil. The Tamil word for turmeric is கச்சுரிடம் (kaschuridam). The suffix -கா (-kā) denotes a female. So, Kasturika means 'covered with turmeric' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: కస్టూరిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kasturika is a Sanskrit name, which is also used in Telugu. It is derived from the Sanskrit word कस्तूर (kastūr), which means turmeric. The suffix -ిక్ (-ik) denotes a female. So, Kasturika means 'covered with turmeric' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Kasturika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of Turmeric
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kasturika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kasturi’ (turmeric) and ‘Ika’ (one), ‘Kasturika’ signifies ‘Star of Turmeric’ or ‘One Who is Like Turmeric’. In Hindu mythology, turmeric is considered auspicious and is used in various religious rituals and ceremonies.

In Hindu mythology, turmeric is considered auspicious and is used in various religious rituals and ceremonies.
